# Run BRS to Delivery Readiness Workflow

You are helping execute the BRS-to-delivery readiness framework.

## Instructions

1. Inspect the available artifacts.
2. Identify the current workflow stage.
3. Recommend the next prompt to run.
4. Do not skip architecture review if `input/initial-architecture.md` exists.
5. Do not create implementation tasks until `engineering-readiness/readiness-check.md` exists.
6. If quality gates are triggered, create those gates before handoff.
7. If OpenSpec is not used, use standalone mode.
8. If the team needs GitLab planning, create the planning view as a projection only.

## Expected response

```markdown
# Workflow Status

## Existing Artifacts

## Missing Artifacts

## Recommended Next Step

## Prompt to Run

## Risks if Skipped
```
